definitions.explanation: Describes a person who has a large physical frame or stature.
Describes fabric, clothing, or designs with large, bold patterns.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大柄|おおがら}な{男性|だんせい}だ。
{大柄|おおがら}な{体格|たいかく}を{生|い}かしてラグビーを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He took advantage of his large build and started playing rugby.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}は{家族|かぞく}の{中|なか}で{一番|いちばん}{大柄|おおがら}で、{百八十|ひゃくはちじゅう}センチ{以上|いじょう}ある。
examples.english: My older brother has the largest build in the family, standing over 180 centimeters tall.

examples.japanese: {大柄|おおがら}な{花柄|はながら}のワンピースを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a dress with a bold floral pattern.

examples.japanese: {大柄|おおがら}のチェックは{目立|めだ}つ。
{小柄|こがら}な{人|ひと}が{大柄|おおがら}な{柄|がら}の{服|ふく}を{着|き}ると{柄|がら}に{負|ま}けてしまうことがある。
examples.english: When a small-framed person wears clothing with bold patterns, the pattern can overpower them.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (large build) is the more common meaning. Often used as a neutral or positive descriptor, without the negative nuance of "fat" or "overweight."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大柄|おおがら}な{人|ひと} (a large-framed person)
- {大柄|おおがら}な{体格|たいかく} (a large build)
- {大柄|おおがら}な{柄|がら} (a bold pattern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小柄|こがら}: small-framed, petite — the opposite
- {細身|ほそみ}: slender, slim — describes body shape rather than frame size
